title: On the Consistency of Fairness Measurement Methods for Regression Tasks
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It studies the consistency of fairness measurement methods for regression tasks, using protected attributes like race and gender.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on the consistency of fairness measurement methods in regression tasks using protected attributes such as race and gender.
